minimax_constant_J: For positive observed tool means lo,hi, best constant under max relative error is2lohi/(lo+hi), minimum worsterror(hi-lo)/(hi+lo). Diagnostic lower bound only, never reuse as heldout fitted predictor.
work_area: Required actual crack-area ratio under commonJ16 is Jg/J16 if ALL difference is attributed to area reference. Additional effective work under syntheticcut150..380 is[Jg-epsJ-380,Jg+epsJ-150]; NOT inferred microscopic interface work.
empirical_link: Unknown changes in repeat-contact/friction/recoverable work appear as DeltaW_nuisance; identical first/repeat is constitutive assumption not conservation identity
